steps.title: Look at the word immediately before each -ing form. Which sentence is the odd one out, and why?
options: Sentence 1 — it has no word before the verb
Sentence 2 — it has a preposition before the verb
Sentence 4 — the verb want takes to + verb, not -ing
Sentence 3 — give up is two words
steps.answer: Sentence 4 — the verb want takes to + verb, not -ing

items: ✓ describe how food tastes — bitter, sour, spicy, savoury, plain
✓ describe how it is prepared and how it feels — raw, boiled, thick, texture
